📢 WE ARE HIRING | Legal Intern
Join Ardh Sainik Legal Associates

Are you a law student or recent law graduate looking to gain practical legal experience? Ardh Sainik Legal Associates is inviting applications for the position of Legal Intern.

📍 Location: Rohini, Delhi
🏢 Company: Ardh Sainik Legal Associates
🕙 Working Hours: 10:00 AM – 06:00 PM

Who Can Apply?
✔️ Law students (3rd year onwards for 5-year course / Final year for 3-year course) or recent law graduates
✔️ Candidates with strong legal research and drafting skills
✔️ Passionate individuals eager to learn and grow in litigation and legal advisory

📩 How to Apply?
Send your CV to ardhsainiklegal@gmail.com with the subject line: "Legal Associate Intern Application"
📱 WhatsApp: 7011426038

Kick-start your legal career with hands-on experience and professional mentorship.
